t: The Milwaukee Carbide Tile and Glass Drill Bit is a 6mm x 60mm tool engineered for precision drilling in various materials. This durable Milwaukee drill bit is ideal for plumbers and tilers undertaking bathroom and kitchen installations, effortlessly handling ceramics, porcelain, and non-toughened glass. Its sharpened carbide tip ensures fast drilling performance, while a reinforced carbide head provides enhanced durability and extended service life. The anti-slip multi-flat shank design offers improved control and prevents slipping in combi drill chucks, making it a reliable choice for demanding wet and dry drilling tasks.
b: Suitable for Tiles, Porcelain, Ceramics & Non-Toughened Glass
